# Records Management Regulation

## Section 1. Purpose

This Regulation sets out how the records of the Company are created, kept and destroyed.

## Section 2. Definitions

In this Regulation, "Records Officer" means the person appointed by the head of each department to manage its records.

## Section 3. Keeping records

(a) The Records Officer keeps the records of the department.

(b) The period for which a record is kept is set out in Section 4.

## Section 4. Retention periods

(a) Contracts and minutes are kept for ten years.

(b) Other records are kept for five years.

## Section 5. Destruction

A record whose retention period has ended is destroyed with the approval of the Records Officer, by a method that does not allow it to be restored.

## Section 6. Exceptions

Despite Section 4(b), a record relating to litigation or an audit is kept until the matter is closed.

## Section 7. Amendment

This Regulation may be amended only by a resolution of the Board.

## Section 8. Commencement

This Regulation comes into force on 1 April 2026.
